title: ALF-Score-A novel approach to build a predictive network-based walkability scoring system
summary: The Active Living Feature Score combines road-network, road-embedding and point-of-interest features, using user ratings as ground truth to estimate walkability. The study reports over 87% accuracy and over 98% conversion consistency on its evaluated road data; transfer to other populations or locations was not established.
ai_technology: Machine-learning spatial-network analysis builds a walkability score from road and environmental features.
organization: Department of Computer Science, Memorial University of Newfoundland, St. John's, Newfoundland, Canada

evidence.tested: The Active Living Feature Score achieved over 87% accuracy and over 98% conversion consistency on the evaluated road data using road-network, embedding and point-of-interest features.
evidence.unknown: Validation is limited to the study’s user-opinion ground truth and road-network sample; transfer to other settings was not shown.
evidence.ai_role: Machine-learning spatial-network analysis builds a walkability score from road and environmental features.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
